mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% annualized over the previous month signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances when CPIAUCSL annualized growth exceeds 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5 percentage points within the last month signals a weakening labor market, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances when UNRATE increases by more than 0.5pp.

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in Real Personal Consumption Expenditures (RSAFS) by more than 2% month-over-month signals a reduction in consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances when RSAFS drops by more than 2%.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Industrial Production (INDPRO) by more than 1% month-over-month signals a strengthening supply side, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances when INDPRO increases by more than 1%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) over three consecutive months signals an easing monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances when FEDFUNDS decreases over three months.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Nonfarm Payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 over the previous month signals a strengthening labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the instances when PAYEMS increases by more than 200,000.

mechanism_narrative: When both Housing Starts (HOUST) and Real Personal Consumption Expenditures (RSAFS) increase by more than 1% month-over-month, it signals a broad-based demand expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances when both HOUST and RSAFS increase by more than 1%.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) exceeds the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) annualized growth rate, it signals a tightening monetary policy relative to inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances when FEDFUNDS exceeds CPIAUCSL annualized growth.
